command -v [--] name
Report a builtin, function, reserved word or executable PATH result.
Uses normal Clarice CLX/script resolution; does not execute the command.
One name per call. No -p/-V or command-execution form yet.
Status: 0 found (or no name), 127 missing, 2 usage.
Example: command -v ls

free [-b|-k|-m|-h] [--]
Report installed RAM and Clarice's current application heap.
Default -k: KiB; -b: bytes; -m: MiB; -h: human readable. Last wins.
Free and largest blocks are not machine-wide free physical RAM.
After-purge values include reclaimable purgeable handles; no purge is
requested. Heap extent excludes the application stack/code outside it;
System 6 partition-wide capacity is not claimed. Values include this
command's temporary image. No Linux swap/buffers/process statistics.
Example: free -b
